notes: Medium (sum 10). Requires deriving host/port/database/user/password from a compose-style service description and opening a live SCRAM-authenticated Postgres connection; the non-default published port, quoting variants, IP-prefixed port notation, and the missing-POSTGRES_DB default (database = user) all have to be handled for the connection to succeed at all. The deliverable program must generalize to hidden compose files with different credentials, databases, port notations, and row sets (including a header-only empty result), so hard-coded connection values or rows fail. Row-level quantitative comparison of the emitted CSV on the live database.
